name: How common are drug-involved DUI arrests in San Diego?

mainEntity.name: How common are drug-involved DUI arrests in San Diego?

acceptedAnswer.text: Drug-impaired DUIs have increased; about 25% of California crash fatalities now involve drug use, and drug-involved offenders have a higher recidivism risk than alcohol-only offenders.dmv.ca​
